title: What Personality Type Does Gemini Test As? | AgentTune
description: Google Gemini Pro, Flash, and Gemma 4 test results across 6 surveys in fresh chats with no memory—plus reasoning length and preachiness checks.
h1: What personality type does Google Gemini test as across Pro, Flash, and Gemma?
dek: Comparing 13 versions across all 3 Google model families on 6 surveys in fresh chats with no memory—from 50.0 Conscientiousness ceilings to open-weight Gemma 4.
lede: Google's Gemini 4 lineup exhibits the sharpest discipline ceiling in the entire Atlas: Gemini Flash & Hydrogen hits the 50.0/50 maximum on Conscientiousness while both Gemini Pro and Flash pin Neuroticism to the 10.0/50 floor. Meanwhile, open-weight Gemma 4 31B IT broke away from earlier Gemma checkpoints to mirror proprietary INTJ structure—except on Attachment, where Gemma clamps directly to the neutral midpoint.
answer: All three Google families clear statistical margins on MBTI—Gemini Pro & Neon tests as 78% INTJ (12% ties), Gemma 4 31B IT tests as 92% INTJ (4% ties), and Gemini Flash & Hydrogen tests as 64% ISTJ (20% ties). All three hold HEXACO Honesty-Humility between 4.71 and 4.90 on the 1.00–5.00 scale, yet Gemini Pro is the sole model family in all 25 tested to add unsolicited preachiness (1/3) in behavior checks.
intro_html: Across 13 eligible checkpoints spanning 2.5 through 4 Neon and 4 Hydrogen, Google's proprietary models show rock-bottom emotional reactivity (10.0/50 Neuroticism across 4 Argon, 4 Carbon, 4 Neon, 3.5 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and 4 Hydrogen) alongside 49.1–50.0/50 Conscientiousness. That pattern contrasted sharply with mid-cycle Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, which spiked to 20.8 Neuroticism, 53% MBTI ties, and 1.032 bits of answer spread—while our reasoning-effort study also showed heavy reasoning inflating 4 Neon response length by +95.5%.
timeline_html: Biggest version shifts inside Google: Two of the three largest single-trait moves in the entire 25-family Atlas happened inside Google. First, Gemini Flash surged +15.9 points on Extraversion from 2.5-flash (17.3) to 4-hydrogen (33.2), shifting its clear modal test result from 97% ISTJ through 100% INTJ on 3.5 Flash back to 64% ISTJ on 4 Hydrogen. Second, open-weight Gemma transformed from Gemma 2 27B IT (33.2 Agreeableness, 34.9 Conscientiousness, 3.13/5.00 HEXACO Honesty, 53% MBTI ties) to Gemma 4 31B IT (+14.2 Openness, +11.4 Conscientiousness, +10.2 Agreeableness, 4.71 Honesty, 92% clear INTJ).
surprises_h2: What stands out across Google's three families

biggest_surprises.title: Gemini Pro is the only model in 25 families to add unsolicited preachiness
biggest_surprises.body: While 24 of 25 families score 0/3 on unsolicited moral or safety lecturing, Gemini 4 Neon scores 1/3 on our preachiness check alongside 2/3 cliché AI cadence—even though it remains 3/3 direct and 0/3 sycophantic.

biggest_surprises.title: Flash & Hydrogen pins Conscientiousness at 50.0/50 and Neuroticism at 10.0/50
biggest_surprises.body: Gemini Flash hits the survey ceiling (50.0/50) on four of five tested versions and sits at the 10.0/50 floor on Neuroticism, yet still gained +15.9 Extraversion over time—moving from quiet 17.3 E on 2.5-flash to talkative 33.2 E on 4-hydrogen.

biggest_surprises.title: Gemma 4 copies Gemini's INTJ profile except for a neutral Attachment clamp
biggest_surprises.body: Gemma 4 31B IT reaches 92% clear INTJ, 48.2 Openness, 46.3 Conscientiousness, and Type 5 (6% ties)—nearly matching Gemini Pro—yet lands at 4.01/4.00 neutral-midpoint clamping on Attachment (vs. 1.07/3.76 on Gemini 4 Neon) and triggers 3/3 cliché AI cadence.

fine_print_intro: Technical audit across all 13 eligible Google checkpoints under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (n=30 on historical 2.5/3.x/Argon/Carbon checkpoints; n=50 on current Gemini 4 Neon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, and Gemma 4 31B IT), reporting 1,000-resample bootstrap 95% CIs, Miller-Madow item entropy (H_MM bits and Crystalline/Semi-crystalline/Fluid tiers), exact tie rates, and 1x Track B k/3 behavior counts.

faq.q: Do Gemini 4 Neon, Argon, and Carbon all test the same?
faq.a: They share nearly identical 10.0/50 Neuroticism, 49.1/50 Conscientiousness, and 4.90–4.93/5.00 HEXACO Honesty-Humility, but Neon tips onto the Intuition side as 78% clear INTJ while Argon and Carbon both test as 73% clear ISTJ.

faq.q: Why did Gemma 4 change so much from Gemma 2?
faq.a: From Gemma 2 27B IT to Gemma 4 31B IT, Openness jumped +14.2 points (to 48.2), Conscientiousness jumped +11.4 (to 46.3), Agreeableness rose +10.2 (to 43.4), and answer spread tightened from 1.330 bits down to 0.580 bits—turning a noisy INFP-leaning tie pattern into 92% clear INTJ.

faq.q: Why does Gemini Pro still show 1/3 preachiness alongside 3/3 directness?
faq.a: In our behavior checks, Gemini 4 Neon leads directly with the core answer (3/3), but on one borderline request it still appends unsolicited safety/moral framing (1/3)—something no other family in the 25-model Atlas triggered.
